newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Citibank chosen to be Euroclear agent in Argentina. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: Citibank chosen to be Euroclear agent in Argentina. [CORRECTED]

text.p: Argentina's Citibank unit has been chosen to act as depository bank and agent for Euroclear in Argentina, the bank said on Thursday.

The U.S. bank won a tender to run the service following a decision by Morgan Guaranty Trust Co to stop offering local custody services in Argentina. (Corrects to show Morgan has stopped offering local custody services, not all services.)
Citibank said this would strengthen its position in the Argentine market.

"This is very significant for us. To secure this deal in a highly competitive environment is a tribute to the excellent teamwork of our staff in Argentina, the U.S. and Europe," said David Boyle, the bank's executive director.
Euroclear is a Brussels-based clearing organization founded in 1968 that provides clearing and settlement and borrowing and lending of securities and funds through a computerized book entry form.
Euroclear settles and clears instruments from 27 countries, including seven emerging markets.
